distinctiveFeatures.description: A prominent gold-toned bird motif is set among dense geometric embroidery on the front.
The patterned jacket is layered over a bright pink long-sleeved garment with smaller scattered motifs.

visualDescription: A bright fuchsia layered kurta and open-front jacket, with a band-style collar, long sleeves, and a mid-thigh-length jacket. Dense geometric and floral-like detailing in gold, cream, black, and small blue and green accents gives the jacket an ornate embroidered appearance, including a prominent gold-toned bird motif on the front.
